scope: G01 render controls: independent synthetic RGB8 oracles for graphics, JPX alpha, stored/generated icons, Ink/Polygon/Line paths, all standard endings, leaders, plain captions, text-markup quads, Caret symbols, all standard stamps, plain FreeText and callouts, common RC/DS rich text, cloudy borders and stored appearance selection, original static Sound icons and stored AP controls, MediaBox-relative FixedPrint screen placement and non-destructive Redact region-outline previews and source Tx/Ch/Btn widget text, normal captions and Form icons through the shared form generator; blank Screen defaults, explicit Movie image posters and required stored-AP subtype controls. Caption/icon partitioning and default toggle marks are reader policy; icon fitting follows Table 250. Pagura and six baseline engines at each fixture's declared 72/144 DPI, first page, white backdrop. Generated artwork and font selection use each reader's default policy; Pagura text expectations use pinned regular/bold AFM/Arimo data and independent original-curve areas; source fixtures provide authored wrapping/sizing controls. Alternate text-markup quad ordering is a reported Pagura repair, rejected by the full strict audit. Pixel disagreement needs artwork/font/sampling/API-layer adjudication; no timing, family support, optional-build or release-parity verdict. Includes accepted R02/R03 image colour/layout, JPX, lossless JPEG, fax and JBIG2 controls; their scope and historical malformed-input observations remain in the probe README.
